test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many Directive Principles of the original list in the Indian Constitution were amended by the 44th Amendment Act of 1978?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 44th Constitutional Amendment act, 1978, inserted Section-2 to Article 38 which declares that; “**The State, in particular, shall strive to minimize economic inequalities in income and eliminate inequalities in status, facilities and opportunities not amongst individuals but also amongst groups”.**
